• Applicants for master’s programmes must have graduated from
a curriculum that is accredited by the Ministry of Education or
the university council. Furthermore, the qualifications of applicants must
meet the requirements set by each programme.
• Applicants for each master’s programmes must have a bachelor’s
degree or equivalent.
• The English proficiency requirement depends on the programme
applicants are applying for.

Doctoral Programmes
• Applicants must have graduated from a curriculum that is accredited
by the Ministry of Education or the university council. Furthermore, the
qualifications of applicants must meet the requirements set by each
programme.
• Applicants for doctoral programmes must have a master’s degree or
equivalent.
• Applicants for doctoral programmes must have a bachelor’s degree
with honours or equivalent.
• Applicants for doctoral programmes must submit their English
proficiency test results according to the following criteria:

The test results must not be older than 2 years from the date of
the exam. In the case that any curriculum has set higher scores, the
criteria by the programme admission shall be used.
• In case that applicants do not have English proficiency test results or
have the results lower than the criteria, they will be accepted to study in
the programme under certain conditions.
• They have to submit English proficiency test results mentioned in the
table above within the first semester of their study or they have to enroll
and pass the ”Academic English for graduate Studies 1” course;
otherwise it will be considered that they have not passed the admission
process and their student status will be revoked.
• Applicants are allowed to submit the result of the ”Academic English
for Graduate Studies 1” course (S grade) that is no older than two years
since an announcement of the grade result.

5
Mae Fah Luang University
Admission Guide 2026
Other Conditions

• The university will not refund the application fee and the tuition fee
regardless of any circumstances.

• Once the applicants have submitted the application form, it means
that they have already studied and verified their qualifications. If it is found
later that the applicants are disqualified, they will not be eligible for
the admission examination.
MFU-TEP
(The Test of English Proficiency)

• MFU-TEP will be held 3-5 times a year of which the exact dates will
be announced by School of Liberal Arts, MFU.

• MFU-TEP consists of 3 parts including: Listening; Grammar and
Written Expression; and Reading.

• Payment of 1,000 THB should be made either by:

- Cash at Finance and Accounting Division, MFU

- Bank transfer to the University’s bank account 672-0-10817-1
Bangkok Bank Public Company Limited, Mae Fah Luang University
Branch

• For more information please contact: School of Liberal Arts, MFU
by Tel: +66(0) 5391 6731
Graduation Conditions

• The students who are eligible to graduate must have an English
proficiency level that corresponds to the set requirement for graduate
students as listed in the MFU announcement entitled “English Proficiency
Test Requirements for Graduate Students at Mae Fah Luang University.” This
requirement is also set in accordance with Mae Fah Luang University’s
Regulations on Graduate Studies.

5 Steps to Apply to MFU
: Choose Your Programme
• Choose one programme that you wish to apply for from the list of programmes offered for

international students. If any further information is required, please visit
https://en.mfu.ac.th/admission/admission-guide.html or email: interadmission@mfu.ac.th
: Submit Application Form and make the payment of application fee
• Applying online at https://en.mfu.ac.th/admission/admission-guide.html
System Instruction: https://shorturl.asia/uyjAk
: Receive Information
• An interview can be held by telephone or Skype video call. Other documents may be required;
in this case, further notification will be sent.
• A list of successful applicants will be announced on the online application system.
: Complete new student information
• Complete all personal information and upload all necessary documents to the new student
registration system
• Pay tuition fees and all expenses in Thai Baht (THB) currency
• Applicants will receive an official acceptance letter with the necessary visa request documents
and acceptance package via email/post.
: Arrive at the MFU Campus
• Inform the Global Relations Division of your arrival details for pickup services
from the Mae Fah Luang - Chiang Rai International Airport or Chiang Rai Bus Station
(1 week in advance).
